metric_definitions.relative_NMSE: mean((y-r)^2/r^2) over finite nonzero reference; not ratio of global powers
metric_definitions.ULP: distance in signed Posit code to RNE(exact real sum)
metric_definitions.percentiles: nearest lower order statistic at floor((N-1)*p/100)
metric_definitions.CI95: Wilson binomial on IID random finite/nonzero stratum; normal mean interval descriptive only

limitations: NaR and exact reference-zero reported separately, no division by zero
Directed first128 not IID and not included in headline random confidence intervals
Standalone shared C_port accuracy; feedback correctness measured by RTL main, no feedback application accuracy claim
Random raw Posit32 codes are not a neural-network workload distribution
